journey.title: Europe & Asia Adventure 2024
journey.description: An incredible journey across two continents, exploring diverse cultures, landscapes, and cuisines

locations.name: London
locations.notes: Started the journey in London. Explored the British Museum, walked along the Thames, and enjoyed traditional fish and chips in Camden Market.

locations.name: Paris
locations.notes: The city of lights lived up to its reputation. Watched sunset from the Eiffel Tower, wandered through Montmartre, and ate too many croissants.

locations.name: Barcelona
locations.notes: Gaudi's architecture blew my mind. La Sagrada Familia is even more impressive in person. Beach days and tapas nights made this unforgettable.

locations.name: Rome
locations.notes: Walking through the Colosseum felt like time travel. Every corner reveals ancient history. The pasta carbonara here ruined all other versions for me.

locations.name: Athens
locations.notes: The Acropolis at sunrise is a spiritual experience. Greek islands day trip was magical. Souvlaki and Greek salad every day!

locations.name: Istanbul
locations.notes: Where East meets West. The Blue Mosque and Hagia Sophia are breathtaking. Grand Bazaar shopping was an adventure. Turkish tea and baklava addiction started here.

locations.name: Dubai
locations.notes: Futuristic city in the desert. Burj Khalifa views are insane. Desert safari and dune bashing was thrilling. The contrast between modern and traditional is fascinating.

locations.name: Mumbai
locations.notes: Sensory overload in the best way. The energy of this city is unmatched. Gateway of India, street food tours, and Bollywood culture everywhere. Spice level: expert unlocked.

locations.name: Bangkok
locations.notes: Temple hopping paradise. Grand Palace is stunning. Street food heaven - pad thai and mango sticky rice daily. Night markets are addictive.

locations.name: Hanoi
locations.notes: Old Quarter charm with motorbike chaos. Halong Bay cruise was otherworldly. Pho for breakfast became a ritual. Vietnamese coffee is liquid gold.

locations.name: Hong Kong
locations.notes: Vertical city with incredible skyline. Dim sum heaven. Tram rides and temple street night market. Perfect blend of Chinese culture and British influence.

locations.name: Tokyo
locations.notes: Everything I imagined and more. Shibuya crossing, peaceful temples, robot restaurants. Sushi, ramen, and convenience store adventures. Technology meets tradition perfectly.

locations.name: Kyoto
locations.notes: Temple city that feels like stepping back in time. Fushimi Inari shrine with thousands of torii gates is magical. Geisha district in Gion. Cherry blossom gardens (though we missed the season).

locations.name: Seoul
locations.notes: K-pop culture everywhere! Palace visits, traditional hanbok wearing, and hiking Bukhansan. Korean BBQ and kimchi varieties I never knew existed. Shopping in Myeongdong was dangerous for my wallet.

locations.name: Singapore
locations.notes: Garden city finale to an epic journey. Marina Bay Sands, Gardens by the Bay, and hawker center food adventures. So clean and organized. Perfect way to end this incredible adventure.
